connectorUiConfig.title: Mimecast Targeted Threat Protection (Serverless)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Mimecast Targeted Threat Protection (TTP) data connector provides the capability to ingest Mimecast TTP logs into Microsoft Sentinel. This includes TTP URL click logs, TTP Attachment protection logs, and TTP Impersonation protection logs.

sampleQueries.description: Get all TTP URL clicks from the last 24 hours
Get all TTP Attachment protection events from the last 7 days
Get all TTP Impersonation protection events

dataTypes.name: MimecastTTPUrl_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: MimecastTTPUrl_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Time=max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: MimecastTTPAttachment_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: MimecastTTPAttachment_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Time=max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: MimecastTTPImpersonation_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: MimecastTTPImpersonation_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize Time=max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Mimecast TTP API Credentials
customs.description: You need Mimecast OAuth2 application credentials (Client ID and Client Secret) with TTP API permissions.

instructionSteps.title: Configure Mimecast API Application
instructionSteps.description:
To integrate with Mimecast TTP, you need to create an API application in your Mimecast account:

1. Log in to your Mimecast Administration Console
2. Navigate to **Administration** > **Services** > **API and Platform Integrations**
3. Click **Add API Application**
4. Provide a name and description for the application (e.g., 'Microsoft Sentinel TTP Integration')
5. Select **Client Credentials** as the authentication type
6. Grant the following API permissions:
   - **TTP URL Logs**: Read permission
   - **TTP Attachment Protection Logs**: Read permission
   - **TTP Impersonation Protection Logs**: Read permission
7. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** for use in the next step
8. Note your Mimecast regional API base URL (e.g., https://api.services.mimecast.com for US region)

parameters.text: Ensure you have admin access to your Mimecast account to create API applications and grant necessary permissions.
